hero.title: Investment Management
hero.subtitle: Your portfolio should be built around your financial life—not the other way around.

blocks.text: Successful investing isn't about chasing returns or finding the next hot stock. It's about building an investment strategy that supports your life, your goals, and your long-term financial plan.

At PointOak, investment management is never viewed in isolation. Every portfolio we build considers your retirement goals, tax considerations, estate-planning considerations, risk tolerance, and income needs. As an independent, fee-only fiduciary, we create personalized investment strategies designed around your goals and broader financial plan—not a proprietary product lineup.
Your portfolio shouldn't simply reflect your age or risk tolerance. It should reflect your entire financial picture.

Investment decisions influence retirement income, taxes, estate planning, charitable giving, and long-term wealth preservation. When those decisions are made independently, opportunities can be missed.
Our approach coordinates every part of your financial life, helping your investments support your broader goals today while adapting as those goals evolve over time.

body.text: We begin with your financial circumstances rather than a predetermined investment product.

body.lead: Your portfolio is structured around factors such as your:
items: Goals | Time Horizon | Risk Tolerance | Income Needs | Tax Considerations | Liquidity Needs | Other Assets
The objective is to give each investment account an appropriate role within your broader financial strategy.

body.text: We build diversified portfolios across appropriate asset classes based on the risk and return characteristics needed to support your financial plan.
Rather than reacting to short-term market headlines, we focus on maintaining an investment strategy aligned with your longer-term objectives while making adjustments when circumstances warrant.
As an independent investment adviser, PointOak isn't limited to a proprietary family of investment products.

Our investment universe can include ETFs, mutual funds, individual securities, separately managed strategies, and alternative investments, depending on what is appropriate for the client and portfolio.
For eligible and appropriate investors, we can also evaluate private-market and alternative strategies through specialized investment platforms and asset managers.
Investment costs matter over time.
We consider expenses alongside investment strategy, diversification, implementation, tax considerations, and other relevant factors when selecting investments for client portfolios.
Where appropriate, PointOak frequently uses low-cost ETFs and index-based investments as building blocks within diversified portfolios.
Investment decisions can create tax consequences.
For taxable accounts, we consider factors such as asset location, capital gains and losses, investment turnover, and withdrawal needs when managing the portfolio.
When broader tax questions arise, we can coordinate with your CPA or tax professional.
Portfolios naturally move away from their intended allocations as markets change.
PointOak monitors client portfolios and rebalances when appropriate to help keep investment exposures aligned with the strategy established for the account.
We also evaluate whether changes in your financial circumstances, goals, income needs, or other planning considerations warrant changes to the portfolio itself.

items.title: Broader access can create more ways to build a portfolio.

body.text: Traditional stocks, bonds, ETFs, and mutual funds remain important building blocks in many portfolios. But for appropriate clients, PointOak can also evaluate investment opportunities beyond the traditional public markets.
Depending on a client's objectives, qualifications, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, time horizon, and broader financial circumstances, that may include:
PointOak evaluates these strategies in the context of the complete portfolio rather than treating alternative investments as standalone products.

The objective isn't to use alternatives simply because they're available. It's to determine whether a particular strategy has an appropriate role in helping diversify sources of return, generate income, manage particular portfolio exposures, or address other specific investment objectives.
PUBLIC MARKETS + PRIVATE MARKETS + ALTERNATIVE STRATEGIES
One coordinated portfolio.

Alternative investments can involve risks and characteristics that differ materially from traditional investments, including limited liquidity, longer investment periods, valuation complexity, higher fees, use of leverage, and different eligibility requirements.
For that reason, alternative investments aren't appropriate for every investor or every portfolio.
PointOak evaluates their potential role alongside the client's overall allocation, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, investment horizon, and financial plan.

sections.title: Is Investment Management Right for You?

blocks.text: Our investment management services are designed for individuals and families with more complex financial lives.

blocks.lead: This service may be a good fit if you:
items: Need help coordinating multiple investment accounts.
Have received an inheritance or business sale proceeds.
Need a second opinion on your current portfolio.
Prefer working with an independent fiduciary advisor.

body.text: We begin by learning about your goals, current investments, financial priorities, and overall picture before making recommendations.
We create a personalized investment strategy that aligns your portfolio with your risk tolerance, retirement goals, tax considerations, and long-term objectives.
Once your portfolio is in place, we monitor investments continuously, rebalance when appropriate, and adjust your strategy as your life and the markets evolve.

blocks.text: Investment management is about more than selecting investments.
Our team combines decades of experience with a fiduciary standard of care, helping clients make thoughtful investment decisions that support every aspect of their financial lives.

As a boutique advisory firm, we intentionally maintain a high-touch service model. You'll work directly with experienced advisors who know your goals, communicate proactively, and remain available whenever questions arise.

a.text: Investment management is the ongoing process of building, monitoring, and adjusting an investment portfolio to help achieve your long-term financial goals. It includes portfolio construction, diversification, risk management, and ongoing oversight.

items.q: How is PointOak different from other investment managers?

a.text: PointOak integrates investment management with retirement planning, tax strategies, estate planning, and other financial decisions rather than treating your portfolio as a standalone service. As an independent, fee-only fiduciary, our recommendations are developed around your goals, circumstances, and the scope of our engagement.

items.q: What does a fee-only investment advisor mean?

a.text: Fee-only advisors are compensated directly by their clients rather than through commissions or product sales. This structure can reduce certain conflicts associated with product sales while keeping the advisory relationship centered on the client's goals.

items.q: Do you use proprietary investment products?

a.text: No. PointOak follows an open-architecture approach, allowing us to select investments from across the marketplace rather than limiting recommendations to proprietary funds.

items.q: How often is my portfolio reviewed?

a.text: We continuously monitor portfolios and recommend adjustments when appropriate. We also meet with clients regularly to review performance, discuss changes in financial goals, and update strategies as needed.

items.q: Can you manage retirement accounts like IRAs and 401(k) rollovers?

a.text: Yes. We help clients manage traditional IRAs, Roth IRAs, taxable investment accounts, inherited accounts, and 401(k) rollovers as part of a coordinated wealth management strategy.
